The door seals of the EPCU S5 are over 20 years old.
Damage of an interior door seal has a direct impact on the ambient conditions inside the clean room (loss of overpressure). In addition, with a spacecraft inside a clean room, the loss of an exterior door seal, would no longer allow us to ensure the security of the room or dock the CCU3 for a transfer.
We have to change 4 exterior door seals first, and then the 6 interior door of the EPCU S5.
